summary: Full e2e test of leave management + role-scoped admin/sub-admin console. Backend: 30/30 pytest pass (leave apply/cancel/balance/quota/overlap, approve/reject incl. sub-admin, leave types CRUD, sub-admin scoping + 403s on admin-only endpoints, employee CRUD, org depts/sites/scope, holidays, notices, activity log, analytics, reports CSV scoping). Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920): admin tabbed console (8 tabs, 7 stat tiles, charts, dept headcount), Team add/edit/remove with persistence after reload, duplicate-email error toast, search + dept filter; employee /leave balance cards CL 12/SL 6/EL 15/LOP ∞, apply, overlap/quota error toasts, cancel; admin Leave approve/reject with prompt note, status filters, balances matrix, leave type add/retire; Org dept/site add/delete + sub-admin coverage chips; holiday add/delete visible on employee /leave; notice post/delete shows on /leave and /dashboard banner; Activity log entries; sub-admin console (Org/Activity hidden, Ravi visible / Anita hidden, headcount 2, role select hidden, shift edit works, no leave-types view, no holiday add); Live Map regression (seeded temp on-duty record) map + markers + LIVE/PAUSED toggle + Route Inspector timeline; /admin/reports loads; employee /admin redirects to /dashboard. Found 1 functional UI bug (pending badge doesn't update), 1 permission gap (self-approval), 1 UX bug (reject prompt Cancel still rejects), and a mobile layout break in the Team rows.

critical.issue: No self-approval guard: a sub-admin (or admin) can approve their OWN leave request. Reproduced: sub-admin applied CL 2026-12-14→15 and then approved it themselves, got 200 {ok:true}. Fix: reject with 403 when req.user_id == actor.user_id (or only allow this for full admins).

minor.issue: scoped_user_ids() adds the sub-admin themselves to their scope, so a sub-admin can edit their OWN shift/break limit (verified: set own break_max_minutes=120 → 200). They can also change their own department/manager_id through /assignment. Think about excluding self for sub-admins.
Any admin or sub_admin can cancel ANY leave request, including approved ones, with no scope check and no activity_log entry.
Leave days count calendar days, so weekends and holidays inside the range are deducted from the balance. A request that crosses into the next year is charged entirely to the start year.
No check for a duplicate code on update (create does check).
Error text shows a float: 'Only 6.0 day(s) of Sick Leave left'.

ui_bugs.issue: After Approve/Reject in the Leave tab the badge keeps the old count (stayed 3 while the real pending count was 1). AdminPanel only re-fetches /admin/leave?status=pending when the tab changes. Fix: pass an onChange/refreshPending callback into LeaveTab and call it after decide().
window.prompt(...) ?? '' means clicking Cancel in the rejection prompt still REJECTS the request with an empty note. Cancel should abort the action.

issues: The employee row's right-hand action column (shrink-0 + EDIT/24/7/RESET FACE/REMOVE) pushes the name/email/department column to almost zero width, so name and email are invisible and department/shift text wraps one word per line. Stack the actions below the info on small screens (e.g. flex-col sm:flex-row).
Role label shows the raw value 'SUB_ADMIN' with an underscore; use 'SUB-ADMIN' to match the Team tags.
Native <input type='date'> browser pickers are used instead of the shadcn Calendar/DatePicker. They work, but look inconsistent with the rest of the UI.

action_items: Block self-approval in POST /api/admin/leave/{id}/decide (return 403 when the request belongs to the actor).
Refresh the leave-pending-badge after approve/reject (callback from LeaveTab into AdminPanel).
In LeaveTab.decide, abort the rejection when window.prompt returns null.
Fix the mobile layout of TeamTab rows (stack the action buttons under the info on small screens).

Optional: exclude sub-admins from editing their own shift/assignment; scope-check and log leave cancellations made by managers; skip weekends/holidays when counting leave days; show the role label as SUB-ADMIN in the header.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1528 lines. Split it into routers (auth, attendance, admin/employees, leave, org, holidays, announcements, analytics, reports).
admin_decide_leave has no scope or self check. The user asked that any manager can approve anyone, but self-approval should still be blocked.

get_current_user prefers the cookie over the Authorization header. That is fine, but worth knowing: a test that sends a Bearer token from a browser session that also holds a cookie authenticates as the cookie user.
leave_balances_for runs one query per employee in /admin/leave/balances (N+1). Acceptable for now; aggregate once the headcount grows.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all flows functional; badge refresh + reject-cancel bugs; mobile Team layout issue)

test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md: admin test_session_admin_001, sub_admin test_session_subadmin_001, employee test_session_emp_001 (session expiry refreshed +7d at the start of testing).
seed_data_creation: Temporary on-duty attendance (rec_TEST_live01) + 2 location pings for Ravi to test the Live Map, removed afterwards. All TEST_ employees, leave requests, holidays, notices, depts/sites and leave types were cleaned up. Ravi's and the sub-admin's break limits were reset to 60, and the sub-admin's coverage was restored to ['Field Operations']. Activity log entries from testing remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_leave_admin_console.py (30 tests, all pass). To retest: (1) the badge decrements right after approve/reject without switching tabs; (2) cancelling the reject prompt leaves the request pending; (3) sub-admin self-approval returns 403; (4) the Team tab at 390px shows names. The Live Map needs an on-duty attendance record to render the map: insert attendance {check_out:null, record_id} + locations with the same record_id. Do not use page.request with a Bearer header while the admin cookie is set, because the cookie wins.
